items.title: 68004_Howard McGhee oral history interview
items.q: When I went out there to play with Art Bronson, you know, with the Bostonians.

ctx.x: When did you know him in Denver?
When I went out there to play with Art Bronson, you know, with the Bostonians.
Yeah, you did mention that. He was from that area?

items.title: 75230_Howard McGhee oral history interview
items.q: And that's when I went up to join Art Bronson and His Bostonians.

ctx.x: You could do better on your own.

I was doing better out there in Albuquerque than I was being with this band. So Lester didn't join the band. He went on to Kansas, to Wichita, Kansas, and he told him about me, and he sent for me, and I joined the band like a dummy. I didn't know that I was supposed to get a salary. He didn't give me nothin' me, man. He gave me two dollars maybe every now and then. And then I had to buy my own food and everything, and it was just... It was horrible. I mean, what kind of job is this, where you work and you don't…
But after I went back with the band, they broke up. So the two Gray boys, Hunter and Henry, went to Denver. They knew the guy, Art Bronson, that had a band called the Bostonians....
